purpose: Teach: やれる/切符/通す/光る/盛り上がる/不公平/仕上がり/固い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、やれる、絶対、わよ、メイちゃん、絶対、応援してる
lines.en: Aoi, I mean it — you absolutely can do this. I'm cheering for you, seriously.
lines.style: Warm, forward-leaning conviction. Slow and deliberate on the key words. Full eye contact. The tone of someone who has already decided you can do it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、切符、絶対、回数券、絶対、扱い始めたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know what? I actually started handling the ticket passes for customers. It's happening.
lines.style: Bright, a little amazed at herself. Quick pace on the listing. Slight rise at the end — still half-believing it. The energy of someone sharing good news.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お電話、絶対、通す、絶対、ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And Aoi, you're going to get those phone calls through. You will.
lines.style: Calm and steady. Spoken like a quiet fact, not a cheerleader moment. Gentle but certain. The reassurance of someone who sees what you don't yet.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、ライト、絶対、光る、絶対、と、絶対、お洒落、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way your shop lights up — it's so beautiful. Customers notice that kind of thing.
lines.style: Admiring, almost soft. Slight pause before 'beautiful' like she's finding the right word. Warm noticing. Not gushing, but genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お話、絶対、盛り上がる、絶対、お客様、絶対、嬉しいよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And when you talk with the customers, they light up. They're happy. You make people happy, Aoi.
lines.style: Tender observation. Speaking slowly, like she's naming something true that Aoi hasn't let herself believe yet. Trailing softly at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、価格、絶対、不公平、絶対、にならないよう、絶対、注意してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You're careful about keeping things fair — with pricing, with everyone. That matters more than you know.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Not flattering — just stating something she's witnessed. Steady and grounded. A little firm, like she's correcting a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新ケーキの、絶対、仕上がり、絶対、楽しみね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I can't wait to see how the new cake turns out. I already know it's going to be beautiful.
lines.style: Eager but patient. Forward-looking, bright. A little conspiratorial — like she's already imagined it. Genuine excitement without pressure.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新作の、絶対、パン、絶対、固い、絶対、わよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though I have to say, the new bread you made came out a bit hard. But you'll figure it out.
lines.style: Dry, affectionate honesty. Light on the criticism. Quick beat before the reassurance. The warmth of telling a friend the truth and not softening it.
